description: Calculates the fare structure of a charter bus trip under Japan's time + distance fare system (billable hours including roll-call, billable km including empty running, night hours, relief-driver flags). Returns a yen reference estimate only when the published rate table has been verified and all routing inputs are present; otherwise returns status 'quote_required'. Never a confirmed price.

garage_in.description: Time the bus returns to its garage, HH:MM (24h).

garage_out.description: Time the bus leaves its garage, HH:MM (24h).

total_km.description: Total km for the day including empty running to/from the garage.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for names and messages: en, ja, zh-CN, zh-TW, ko, th, id, fr, de, es or it. Defaults to en.

vehicle_id.description: Vehicle id from list_charter_bus_options, e.g. coach-45.

name: estimate_charter_bus_price
title: Estimate a charter bus fare
